data.name: Header_Intro
data.value: Making dialysis care accessible to patients who cannot afford it.

data.name: Header_ImageAlt
data.value: A nurse accompanies a patient in a wheelchair.

data.name: Origin_Body
data.value: The foundation was born after the loss of Ida Bass, taken by kidney disease for lack of access to proper treatment. It carries her name.

data.name: Help_Body
data.value: For patients who cannot afford treatment, the foundation covers all or part of the cost of dialysis, lab tests and medication, based on financial need.

data.name: Donate_Body
data.value: Every donation goes directly toward a patient's treatment.
